title: Inter 2-1 Fiorentina: both goals after 90' | Jones & Pavard derby doubt #Shorts
description:
Inter don't lose. They just finish late.

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 26 — Inter beat Fiorentina 2-1 at San Siro. Thuram equalized 90+1', Zielinski's penalty won it 90+8'; Jimenez had put Fiorentina ahead on 64'.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 26 — Lautaro Martínez is one of 30 players on the 2026 Ballon d'Or shortlist. The ceremony is tonight at the London Palladium; the club published no start time.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 25 — Ivan Provedel made his Inter debut in goal, completing 30 of 31 passes.
REPORTED · Corriere dello Sport via FCInterNews · Oct 25 — Curtis Jones and Benjamin Pavard both have adductor trouble. The paper calls the derby on Oct 31 unlikely and Feyenoord on Nov 3 the likely return.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews · Oct 25 — Federico Dimarco is asking about €7.5m a season to renew, against about €5.2m now. Inter are in no hurry.

Next up: Venezia away, Wed, Oct 28 — 1:30 PM ET / 18:30 CET. US TV: Paramount+, Peacock Premium.
